name: Manley Variable Mu
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Threshold, attack and output are knob positions and recovery is in words (Slo ... Fast): none of them mean anything on other compressors. They come back as you left them when you return to the Variable Mu, as do Comp/Limit, the matrix and link settings.
The L Bypass switch (In / Bypass) stands in for the compressor's in/out, with Ctrl Link moving R with it. Mix is read through a measured table.
